Tests rent sysvar decode bounds and minimum balance calculations.

# Purpose
This file is a unit test for the `fd_sysvar_rent` code. It checks that a real on-chain rent sysvar account decodes to the expected footprint and alignment by calling `fd_rent_decode_footprint` and `fd_rent_align`. It also verifies `fd_rent_exempt_minimum_balance` against a fixed set of test vectors that cover different account data lengths, rent rates, and exemption thresholds. The [`test_sysvar_rent`](<#test_sysvar_rent>) function runs both the decode check and the minimum-balance checks with `FD_TEST` assertions.
